# Data loading (StemAI)

```{r stemai-setup-01, include = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_config.R"), local = TRUE)
cohort_extended_hem <- TRUE
cohort_rds_path <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  here::here("data", "HMA_BCL2_cohort_assignments_TNBC_Lymphoma.rds")
} else {
  file.path("data", "HMA_BCL2_cohort_assignments_TNBC_Lymphoma.rds")
}
if (!file.exists(cohort_rds_path) || file.size(cohort_rds_path) < 1000) {
  cohort_rds_path <- if (requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
    here::here("data", "HMA_BCL2_cohort_assignments.rds")
  } else {
    file.path("data", "HMA_BCL2_cohort_assignments.rds")
  }
}
```

## Open-source inputs: DepMap, GDSC, CTRP (cell-line layer)

```{r load-depmap-stemai, cache = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("scripts", "load_depmap_for_rmd.R"), local = FALSE)
```

```{r load-cohort-tnbc-lymph, cache = FALSE}
child_path <- here::here("rmarkdown", "01_Data_Loading_TNBC_Lymphoma.Rmd")
if (!file.exists(child_path)) stop("Missing cohort child: ", child_path)
knitr::knit_child(child_path, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r stem-like-labels, cache = FALSE}
if (exists("expr_target") && nrow(expr_target) > 0) {
  expr_target <- expr_target %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stem_like_group = assign_stem_like_group(.data$lineage_group),
      stem_like_subtype = assign_stem_like_subtype(.data$lineage_group),
      validation_partition = "seen"
    )
}
```

## TCGA (patient-tumor layer, unseen validation)

```{r load-tcga-stemai, cache = FALSE}
tcga_rds <- file.path(stemai_data_dir, "StemAI_tcga_harmonized.rds")
if (!file.exists(tcga_rds) || file.size(tcga_rds) < 500) {
  tryCatch(source(here::here("scripts", "load_tcga_stemai.R"), local = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}
tcga_stemai <- tibble::tibble()
tcga_stemai_status <- tibble::tibble()
if (file.exists(tcga_rds)) {
  tcga_obj <- readRDS(tcga_rds)
  tcga_stemai <- tcga_obj$tcga
  tcga_stemai_status <- tcga_obj$status
}
```

## Cohort harmonization table (Panel 1)

```{r tbl-cohort-harmonization}
if (exists("expr_target") && nrow(expr_target) > 0) {
  tbl_cohort <- expr_target %>%
    dplyr::count(.data$stem_like_subtype, .data$stem_like_group, name = "N_expr") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$N_expr))
  knitr::kable(tbl_cohort, caption = "Table 1. StemAI cohort after harmonization (expression layer). Stem-like subtypes include SCLC, ExPulm-SCNEC, AML, DLBCL/high-grade lymphoma, neuroblastoma.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(Note = "expr_target not loaded; run DepMap cache and cohort assignment."), caption = "Table 1.")
}
if (nrow(tcga_stemai_status) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(tcga_stemai_status, caption = "TCGA input status (unseen validation partition).")
}
```

```{r save-workspace-stemai-01, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
obj_names <- c(
  "expr_target", "expr_meta", "lineage_levels", "meta",
  "tcga_stemai", "tcga_stemai_status", "gdsc_dir", "depmap_cache_path",
  "merged_aza", "merged_bcl2i_gdsc", "pair_df", "have_gdsc", "have_ctrp", "prism_expr",
  "STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE", "STEMAI_STEM_LIKE_LEVELS"
)
obj_names <- obj_names[sapply(obj_names, exists, where = .GlobalEnv)]
if (length(obj_names) > 0) {
  tmp_ws <- paste0(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS, ".tmp")
  save(list = obj_names, file = tmp_ws)
  if (file.exists(tmp_ws) && file.size(tmp_ws) > 1000) {
    ok <- tryCatch({ readRDS(tmp_ws); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    if (ok) file.rename(tmp_ws, STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS) else unlink(tmp_ws)
  }
}
```
